lines.text: They carry the ark from the house of Abinadab on the shoulders of Levites, celebrating with songs, harps, and trumpets.
At Chidon's threshing floor, Uzzah takes hold of the ark when oxen stumble, and the LORD strikes him.

problems.problem: Its wrong detail "on a king's chariot" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
It has 21 words. Each line is 20 words or fewer.
